The plan

About this event

The plan, loosely:

  • 6:00 Doors. Snacks and drinks while the first pot boils.
  • 6:30 Folding lesson. Pleats are optional; enthusiasm is not.
  • 7:30 Eat. Repeat.
  • 9:00 Games, leftovers, arguments about dipping sauce.

Pork-and-cabbage and a vegetarian filling are covered. If you’re bringing something, add it below so we get a good spread. Ugly dumplings are still dumplings.
